case.summary: Customer C08623 reported a disputed $49.00 in-person purchase (transaction 3530164), aligning with an out-of-region fraud pattern and an 85% fraud probability. Evidence reviewed includes the customer's high-mobility profile—spanning 53 billing regions and 37 devices—along with similar confirmed fraud cases in case memory. Because the customer denied the charge, Rule R2 applies, mandating that we block the card and create a case. Additional reporting was not triggered since the exposure remains under $1,000 and there is no shared device profile or cross-card fraud linkage.
